steps.title: Place Your Base
text: Put your base at the top of your play area, facing your opponent's base.
Each base has its own HP value shown on the card. It provides 1 aspect icon for playing cards.

steps.title: Place Your Leader
text: Put your leader below your base, horizontal (non-unit) side faceup.
Your leader provides 2 aspect icons. Its Epic Action ability will let you deploy it as a powerful unit later in the game.

steps.title: Determine First Player
text: Randomly choose who gets the initiative counter.
Randomly pick a player. That player decides who starts with the initiative counter — they can keep it or give it to their opponent.
The player with the initiative takes the first action of the game.

steps.title: Shuffle & Draw
text: Shuffle your deck, then draw 6 cards.
Both players shuffle their decks and draw 6 cards as their opening hand.

steps.title: Mulligan (Optional)
text: You may shuffle your hand back and draw a new hand of 6 cards.
The player with the initiative decides first, then their opponent.
You can only take one mulligan, and you must keep the new hand.
Tip: Take a mulligan if your hand has no units that cost 1 or 2.

steps.title: Resource Two Cards
text: Choose 2 cards from your hand and put them into play facedown and ready as resources.
Resources are used to pay for cards you play. Each player must resource exactly 2 cards.
A card used as a resource is placed facedown — its text and abilities are inactive while it's a resource.
The game begins with the first action phase.

steps.title: Deck — Card Limits
text: Minimum 50 cards (no maximum limit) in Premier/Eternal format.
Exactly 1 Leader and 1 Base — these exist alongside your deck and don't count toward the minimum.
Up to 3 copies of any unit, event, or upgrade card.

steps.title: Deck — Aspect Rules
text: You may include cards of ANY aspect in your deck, regardless of your Leader and Base aspects.
When playing a card with aspect icons beyond those provided by your Leader and Base, you must pay 2 extra resources per unmatched icon — this is the "aspect penalty."
Neutral cards (gray border, no aspect icons) never incur the aspect penalty.

steps.title: Deck — Sideboard
text: Up to 10 cards to swap between games in a match.
**Play Area Layout**
Your play area is arranged as follows:
bullets: **Base zone** — Your base card sits top center. This is what your opponent is trying to destroy.
**Leader zone** — Your leader sits below your base, starting on its horizontal (non-unit) side faceup.
**Ground arena** — Ground units are played in a row on one side of your base. Ground units can only attack other ground units, or the enemy base directly.
**Space arena** — Space units are played in a row on the other side of your base. Space units can only attack other space units, or the enemy base directly.
**Resource zone** — Cards placed facedown here become resources, used to pay costs.
**Deck** — Your draw pile. Cards enter your hand from here.
**Discard pile** — Defeated units and used events go here faceup.

text: **Ground & Space Arenas**
Combat is divided into two separate arenas: ground and space. Each unit card shows its arena type at the top.
A ground unit can't attack a space unit, and a space unit can't attack a ground unit — they fight in separate lanes.
However, any unit can attack the enemy base directly, regardless of arena.
**Ready & Exhausted**
Cards are either ready (upright) or exhausted (turned sideways).
Units and resources enter play exhausted, then become ready at the end of the regroup phase.
You must exhaust resources to pay for cards. You must exhaust a unit to attack with it. An exhausted card can't be exhausted again until it's readied.
